thread:
violet: Observed a reproducible SSE problem in the browser sample when aborting then immediately reconnecting. Error shows up as `Unexpected token` in user logs.
rahul: Which SDK + sample? any raw frames?
violet: browser-sdk@2.0.6 + sample-web. Repro: start stream emitting small events (~8), call `abort()` around event 4, then open a new stream right away. We see either parse errors or a duplicate/late event.
emily: can you paste the raw bytes you captured with SDK_DEBUG=raw?
violet: pasted sanitized frames:
```
data: {"id":1,"t":"one"}\n\n
data: {"id":2,"t":"two"}\n\n
data: {"id":3,"t":"three"}\n\n
data: {"id":4,"t":"four"}\n\n\n<abort>
[after reconnect sometimes:]
data: {"id":5,"t":"five"}\n\n
data: {"id":4,"t":"four"}\n\n\nOR glued case:
data: {"id":4,"t":"four"}
data: {"id":5,"t":"five"}\n\n
```
rahul: Classic missing-final-LF: abort path can drop the last `\n` so the `data:` header of next chunk attaches. Also saw corporate proxy that strips a trailing LF on close.
emily: There was a second failure mode in a customer report: reconnect races with auth refresh. If the reconnect happens while token refresh is in-flight, request can go with expired token and server returns 401 body which fed into the SSE parser as bytes and causes a parse error.
violet: So two separate but related pain points: (A) newline truncation leading to glued frames, (B) auth-refresh race surfacing as parse error. Both produce `Unexpected token` and are noisy for customers.
rahul: Mitigation plan: 1) Parser resilience: normalize CRLF->LF at read boundary, split on double-newline as primary, but on JSON parse failure attempt a fallback split on `\ndata:` and trim leading tokens. Keep a small partial buffer for incomplete JSON. 2) Dedupe: maintain a rolling set of recent event ids (last N) to drop duplicates if server re-emits on resume. 3) Reconnect behavior: await token refresh promise before issuing retry, and add a tiny jitter (50-200ms) on platforms with flaky socket teardown (Windows/Electron/mobile). 4) Logging: recommend `SDK_DEBUG_SSE=raw` and include token refresh logs in reports.
emily: Also recommend stashing partial buffer keyed by client id for ~500ms so immediate reconnect can resume and append incoming data rather than starting fresh and risking reparse. That helps on mobile where backgrounding can tear sockets and deliver buffered bytes later.
violet: I prototyped a small change in the browser-sdk: normalize newlines, keep partial buffer for 500ms, on parse error try split-on-`\ndata:` fallback, and delay reconnect until token refresh resolves. Local runs (500 cycles) reduced failures from ~3.8% -> 0.2%.
auth-bot: Auth service confirmed: token refresh endpoint is relative quick but client must await `getToken()` promise to avoid 401s during reconnect.
rahul: Good. Please open a PR with: unit tests for glue/abort/reconnect, integration test simulating proxy stripping final LF, auth-race test that forces 401 then refresh, and a README troubleshooting entry.
violet: Will do. I'll also add a note suggesting servers may optionally emit an `X-Chunk-Seq` header for cheap dedupe, but we'll not change server behavior by default.
ci-bot: ci started for branch violet/sse-resilience-auth-wait  build #993 queued.
emily: Add changelog entry for the next patch: "Fix: SSE parser resilience to truncated/newline-glued frames and avoid auth-refresh race on reconnect". Also include recommended SDK env flags for diagnostics.
violet: Final status: after parser + auth-wait changes and 1000 local cycles, zero parse errors. Pushed a small sample README update and will file the PR shortly. last log: 2330001500 (reacted :eyes:).
